profile.role_note: A free 4-star Heavy Attack buffer. His Outro grants 38% Heavy Attack DMG.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Mortefi is a free 4-star Heavy Attack buffer for Jiyan and friends. Build him. He is not worth chasing on banners — he can come from any Convene banner.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Static Mist (or Cadenza) + 5-piece Moonlit Clouds in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout, with Impermanence Heron in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Fusion DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and enough Energy Regen to cast his Liberation every rotation. Empyrean Anthem only beats Moonlit Clouds at S4+.

ranked_weapons.name: Static Mist
ranked_weapons.note: A standard 5-star. Crit Rate, Energy Regen, and ATK for the next Resonator on Outro. It is not a signature — he has none, as a 4-star.

ranked_weapons.name: Cadenza
ranked_weapons.note: Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill, which smooths rotations. The free last-resort alternative is the 3-star Pistols of Voyager.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Energy Regen for Liberation uptime, plus an ATK buff for the next Resonator. Heron adds Resonance Energy and more DMG to the next character.

echo_sets.name: Empyrean Anthem
echo_sets.note: Only recommended at S4+. Otherwise Moonlit Clouds is the ideal pick, per Game8.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds + Molten Rift
echo_sets.note: Slightly more personal damage, at the cost of the full 5-pc ATK buff.

stat_priorities.note: Balance Crit for his coordinated-attack damage.
Fusion DMG on both. Swap one to Energy Regen if his Liberation is not cycling.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; enough to cast Liberation every rotation (swap a 3-cost to ER if needed)

teams.name: Classic: Jiyan + Mortefi + Verina

members.name: Jiyan
members.note: The best Mortefi partner: in his Liberation state every attack is a fast Heavy Attack.

members.name: Mortefi
members.note: Outro grants 38% Heavy Attack DMG; his Liberation turret fires on Heavy and Basic Attacks.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Heals and buffs; doubles as an excellent buffer alongside Mortefi.

teams.rotation: Verina heals and buffs. Mortefi sets up his Liberation turret and swaps out for the 38% Heavy Attack buff. Then Jiyan enters his Liberation state and tears through enemies with rapid Heavy Attacks while the turret fires alongside.

teams.name: Alternative: Augusta + Mortefi + Shorekeeper

members.name: Augusta
members.note: Heavy-attack hypercarry; benefits from Mortefi's 38% Heavy Attack DMG Outro.

members.name: Mortefi
members.note: Heavy Attack buffer and coordinated-attack sub-DPS on Empyrean Anthem at S4+.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm buffs and healing with minimal field time.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper sets up Stellarealm. Mortefi drops his Liberation and swaps out for the Heavy Attack buff. Then Augusta takes her long Heavy Attack window under full buff coverage.

His skill casts trigger Marcato coordinated attacks. Huge for Jinhsi teams.
17s of Liberation uptime. The biggest quality-of-life jump he has.
A team-wide 20% ATK buff. Chase it over time with 4-star dupes.
